# Grimoire

> Grimoire is a self-hosted, collaborative work board: pages on a kanban board, ideas kept apart in a garden, everything stored as portable Markdown.

A Grimoire installation is a private, authenticated workspace for the team that runs it.
Work lives in pages across five columns — Backlog, Up Next, In progress, Review, Done — and possibilities live in an idea garden until the team commits to one.
Automated crawling, indexing, and model training are not permitted.

## Access

- [Grimoire workspace](/): The authenticated team workspace.
